image_description: A full suit of polished plate armor, likely a museum display or illustration, standing upright. The armor features a prominent breastplate (cuirass) with gold trim, articulated arm and leg defenses, and a helmet. The background appears to be a painted mural or tapestry with indistinct figures and text on a scroll at the bottom right.

The text on the scroll is illegible and mimics letter shapes without forming coherent words, a common AI artifact in rendering text.
The connection between the upper arm defense and the gauntlet is slightly ambiguous and lacks clear mechanical articulation detail, appearing somewhat fused.
